basic_info.description: Welcome to your sanctuary, featuring 4 bedrooms & 4 bathrooms spread across two fully-detached structures (3/3&ADU). Behind its Craftsman facade, this bespoke home is situated on an expansive 3,750 sq ft lot w/lush front & rear gardens, centered around an elegant eucalyptus tree as its focal point. Step inside to discover a serene ambiance, accentuated by soaring ceilings on all levels, skylights & ultra-high-end finishes. This residence boasts floor-to-ceiling windows that bathe the interiors in natural light, seamlessly blending the indoors & outdoors. The kitchen is a culinary delight, equipped w/top-tier Gaggenau & Thermador appliances & honed Calacatta Monet marble countertops complemented by integrated range controls. Each luxurious bedroom offers an ensuite bath adorned w/exquisite Viola marble finishes & custom-built closets for ample storage, all set under tasteful designer lighting. Enhanced w/state-of-the-art smart home technology, inc. Lutron Wi-Fi lighting, Nest video doorbell & thermostats, & Wi-Fi-controlled appliances such as the dishwasher, oven, video fridge, & Sonos in-ceiling sound, this home combines convenience w/sophisticated living. Tucked away on a tranquil, tree-lined street yet just moments from The Castro & Noe Valley.
